summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no changes made):**  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `/api/watchlist*` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite. Contrary to the ticket's assumption, I did **not** find an obvious wiring bug like a missing `X-User-Id`, a localStorage/anonymous fallback, or unscoped queries:  - The client fetch wrapper sends `credentials: "include"` on every call, and the watchlist page has no local/guest storage — it only ever renders server data. - Every watchlist
